data.text:
"Create start_oauth_login.py in the current working directory.
Task: starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: start_oauth_login.py
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import sys
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+
+
+def _b64url(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    client_id = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+    if not client_id:
+        print("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    domain = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+    if not domain:
+        print("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    redirect_uri = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback")
+    scope = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    verifier = _b64url(secrets.token_bytes(32))
+    challenge = _b64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
+
+    auth_url = "https://{}/authorize?{}".format(
+        domain,
+        urllib.parse.urlencode(
+            {
+                "response_type": "code",
+                "client_id": client_id,
+                "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+                "scope": scope,
+                "state": state,
+                "code_challenge": challenge,
+                "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+            }
+        ),
+    )
+
+    print(auth_url)
+    if os.environ.get("AUTH0_OPEN_BROWSER", "1") != "0":
+        webbrowser.open(auth_url)
+
+    print(state)
+    print(verifier)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
